title: Hindsight Relabeling is All You Need for Reach-Avoid Learning
abstract: arXiv:2505.19337v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning methods have shown promise for reach-avoid tasks, where an agent must reach a target state while avoiding undesirable regions of the state space. Existing approaches typically encode avoid-region information into an augmented state space and cost function, which prevents flexible, dynamic specification of novel avoid-region information at evaluation time. They also rely heavily on meticulously designed reward and cost functions, limiting transferability to novel environments and specifications. We introduce RADT, a decision transformer approach for offline, reward-free, goal-conditioned, avoid-region-conditioned RL. RADT encodes goals and avoid-regions directly as prompt tokens, allowing any number of avoid-regions of arbitrary size to be specified at evaluation time. translated_title: 后见之明重标注即抵达-规避学习所需的一切
translated_abstract: 离线目标条件强化学习方法在抵达-规避任务中展现出良好前景，这类任务要求智能体在抵达目标状态的同时避开状态空间中的不良区域。现有方法通常将规避区域信息编码到增广状态空间和代价函数中，这阻碍了在评估时对新规避区域信息进行灵活、动态的设定。此外，这些方法还严重依赖精心设计的奖励和代价函数，限制了对新环境和新规范的可迁移性。我们提出RADT，一种用于离线、无奖励、目标条件、规避区域条件强化学习的决策Transformer方法。RADT将目标和规避区域直接编码为提示token，允许在评估时指定任意数量、任意大小的规避区域。仅使用来自随机策略的次优离线轨迹，RADT即可在完整……（原文摘要在此处截断）中学到抵达-规避行为。
tldr: 本文提出RADT，一种基于决策Transformer的离线无奖励强化学习方法，通过将目标与规避区域直接编码为提示token，仅凭随机策略产生的次优离线轨迹即可学会抵达-规避行为，并能在评估时灵活指定任意数量和大小的规避区域。
en_tdlr: RADT is a decision transformer approach for offline, reward-free, goal- and avoid-region-conditioned RL that encodes goals and avoid-regions as prompt tokens, enabling reach-avoid behavior to be learned solely from suboptimal random-policy trajectories while flexibly specifying any number of avoid-regions of arbitrary size at evaluation time.
